preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.strip()) <= 100 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit())
preconditions.description: The first line is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 100) representing the number of test cases. Each subsequent line is an integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 100) representing the number of teams in a test case.
The input contains exactly t + 1 lines: one for t and one for each test case's n.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.split()) == n * (n - 1) // 2 for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output line contains exactly n(n-1)/2 integers, representing the results of all games in the specified order.

postconditions.expression: all(-1 <= int(result) <= 1 for result in output_line.split()) for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip()
postconditions.description: Each game result is either -1 (loss for team x), 0 (tie), or 1 (win for team x), where x is the first team in the pair.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(3 if result == 1 else 0 if result == -1 else 1 for result in game_results) == total_score for game_results in [stdout.splitlines()[i].split() for i in range(1, len(stdout.splitlines()))])
postconditions.description: For each test case, every team's total score is equal, where total_score is the common score derived from the game results. The score for a team is calculated as: 3 points for each win, 1 point for each tie, and 0 points for each loss.

postconditions.expression: all(min(ties for ties in [sum(1 for result in game_results if result == 0) for game_results in [stdout.splitlines()[i].split() for i in range(1, len(stdout.splitlines()))]]) == 0 if n % 4 == 0 else min(ties for ties in [sum(1 for result in game_results if result == 0) for game_results in [stdout.splitlines()[i].split() for i in range(1, len(stdout.splitlines()))]]) == (n % 4 == 2))
postconditions.description: The number of ties in the output is minimized. If n is divisible by 4, the minimum number of ties is 0. Otherwise, if n ≡ 2 mod 4, the minimum number of ties is 1. For other values of n, the minimum number of ties is 0 (achievable by a valid configuration).
